explanation: This fires only at D1 and only in roughly the first 40 trials of the episode, building up over a run of unrewarded trials: about 0-3 after the first loss, 7-8 after the second in a row and 10 after the third, at which point the agent switches choice (often 8-9 more on the next D1 if that trial also went unrewarded, then back to 0). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, 0 at any D1 after a rewarded trial (which resets the run), and stays at or near 0 even after consecutive losses later in the episode (after about trial 45).
